declared: 2026-10-31, WP-12 Phase 3 Layer 6, written before any surface_live_NNN Native episode. Physics (tlmpm_v5 law 8, final_v4), goal evaluators, every v1-v4 and goal threshold, the blade_master_flat_board_v1 record, the Phase 2b protocol (configs/wp12/workcell_live_v1.json) and its records are unchanged. Failed runs are kept; any rule change is a new stage file.
scope: LIVE Native Isaac Sim 6.2 only. Re-runs Phase 2b episodes with the opt-in surface_profile='cut_aware_surface_v1' (rendered specimen surface; cut_events_v1 recorder on). The surface is one-way render geometry: it never feeds back into physics and is not the collider. Material parameters remain provisional and uncalibrated. One seed per episode, no repeat statistics.
inputs: Each episode is prepared by scripts/run_wp12_workcell_live.py prepare() from configs/wp12/workcell_live_v1.json (same scene, goal, planner overrides, duration rule, history stride, seed 42), so the live task id must equal the Phase 2b record's.

runtime.runner: scripts/run_wp10_live.py --runtime isaac_sim --scene/--goal with the Phase 2b flags plus --surface-profile <profile> --surface-timing-log

episodes.reason: A vs B profiling on the same task: the default surface with the in-memory timing trace written (--surface-timing-log); the profile flag particle_surface_v1 resolves to the recorded default kernel current_volume_v1

physics_unchanged_rule.text: The surface must not change physics. Per episode, compared with its Phase 2b record (GPU float32 atomics make Native repeatable at verdict level only, WP-11): (1) task id equal; (2) goal verdict and outcome class equal (PARTIAL: the declared PARTIAL_CUT_ACCEPTED conditions of workcell_live_v1.json); (3) mechanical piece count equal; (4) piece mass fractions / removal fraction within 0.02 absolute; (5) labelled particle count and conflicting cross-plane link count reported (not scored).

surface_measurements_report_only.audit: per extraction: audit ok, lattice pieces, mesh shells vs mechanical components (welded faces = shell_component_violations > 0; dropped fragment = component without a shell; phantom = shell without its own lattice piece), visually separated but mechanically bridged components (shown, never hidden)
surface_measurements_report_only.hermite: per extraction: crossings by source (recorder / sign-inconsistent midpoint / point with fallback normal / midpoint fallback), log entries not links / not conflicting / duplicates
surface_measurements_report_only.temporal: frame-to-frame vertex motion at unchanged codes (same codes SHA256 as the previous extraction) vs the largest particle motion of the same interval
surface_measurements_report_only.mesh: vertices, triangles, cut triangles, boundary / non-manifold / inconsistently oriented edges, degenerate triangles (reference mesh)
surface_measurements_report_only.timings: ms per extraction: cut-event log fetch, partition, topology+QEF, quads, embedding, audit, validity, world transform, normals, USD upload; per step: material (TLMPM incl. recorder kernels), robot physics, surface update, camera capture, step wall; GPU process memory
surface_measurements_report_only.media: the Phase 2b close-up views (start / progress / final) via scripts/export_wp12_workcell_media.py and MP4 via scripts/render_packed_episode.py for CUT and Test B, in docs/media/wp12/surface_live/<media>/
